Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting small school districts from certain laws and rules.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school districts with an enrollment of less thanthree thousand students; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.320RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.320RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All school districts with a student enrollment of less thanthree thousand students are exempt from all state statutes and rulesapplicable to school districts and school district boards of directorsexcept as provided in this section. (2) All such school districts may elect to comply with one or moreprovisions of the statutes or rules that are applicable to schooldistricts and school district boards of directors. (3) All such school directors shall: (a) Comply with state and federal health, safety, and civil rightslaws applicable to school districts; (b) Participate in the elementary, middle school, and high schoolstandards and assessment examinations as required in RCW 28A.655.061; p. 1 SB 6147 (c) Employ instructional staff certificated in accordance withrules adopted under RCW 28A.410.010, but may hire noncertificatedinstructional staff of unusual competence and in exceptional cases asprovided for in RCW 28A.150.260(3)(a); (d) Comply with the employee record check requirements in RCW28A.400.303; (e) Be subject to the same financial and audit requirements asother school districts; (f) Comply with the annual school performance report under RCW28A.655.110; (g) Comply with the open public meetings act in chapter 42.30 RCW;and (h) Comply with chapters 41.56, 41.58, and 41.59 RCW.
